description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notification under the Customs Ordinance (Revenue Protection Order No. 08/2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters, specifically the amendment of customs duties and regulations under the Customs Ordinance. It contains a parliamentary resolution modifying import duty rates, concession lists, and exemption provisions, which falls squarely under legal framework and regulatory matters (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
